speaker: Doctor
text: Given your significant weight loss, night sweats, and recent release from prison, I am concerned about tuberculosis. Do you currently have any fever or produce sputum, and if so, is it bloody?

text: My main symptom is Chronic cough and fever. I also have Weight loss, Night sweats, Generalized weakness, Poor appetite.
